svg.title: Axe cuts the vertical length of a complex screen by 59.6 percent
svg.desc: Two editor mockups showing 166 lines of original TSX next to 67 Axe lines; the Axe side illustrates B(w+) shorthand and the historical 59.6 percent vertical reduction.
svg.text: A complex view, visible at a glance.
Representative line-density visualization • same authored screen • fixed line height
